rationale: Independent reading: held EO 8168 (4 FR 2415, June 14, 1939) revokes the Aug. 12, 1898 order and reserves Sitka, Alaska lands for the Coast and Geodetic Survey magnetic/seismological observatory; no own term. Held EO 8854 (6 FR 4181, Aug. 16, 1941; confirmed the text ending '[No. 8854]' on that page) para. 1: 'Executive Order No. 8168 of June 14, 1939 ... is hereby revoked'; para. 2 makes a new withdrawal and reservation of the same and adjoining land under the President's own authority. Whole revocation; the new reservation is EO 8854's own act, not a continuation of EO 8168. Independent status NO, agrees. D6: history has only EO 8854 revocation leads; held texts naming 8168 are EO 8853/8855/8856 (copies of the same FR page carrying EO 8854) and EO 8169 (copy of 8168's own page); no amendment, revival or earlier end ignored. Accept.
